paragraphs.text: Braulios is a centaur scout from Theros .
Your claim to this land is as tenuous as my tolerance of your presence on it.

Braulios is a character who was first mentioned in Theros before later debuting in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Red Zealots deck . They are a scout and archer of the Pheres Band , a collection of centaur nomads and raiders who roam between Setessa and Akros . They are known for their belief that the herd is only as strong as its weakest member, training up the weakest to be able to hold their own against multiple minotaurs.
